people.name: Mr. Rajiv Dube
people.bio: Mr. Rajiv Dube is an industry veteran with over 40 years of multi-sector experience at Tata and Aditya Birla. An engineer and post-graduate in Business Management, he served as President of Tata Motors' car business and executive director at Aditya Birla group.

people.name: Ms. Kalpana Merchant
people.bio: Ms. Kalpana Merchant has over 45 years of experience in the legal profession, spanning commercial property, infrastructure, project finance, dispute resolution, capital markets, and mergers and acquisitions. She is a partner at Kanga & Co., AZB & Partners and Jerome Merchant + Partners, holding LL.B. and B.A. degrees.
